name: Policy: $500/month basic income, tax-financed
description: A $500 monthly payment to every adult, financed by an income-tax surcharge that covers the payment in full, with a 30% tax on AI spend covering part of the bill on top. Balanced-budget by construction: the surcharge takes back what the transfer pays out, so the run shows the redistribution, not a deficit stimulus (the deficit-financed version is variant policy-ubi-deficit).
